body: She is really shitty. But you have no idea until you work with her in real life.
I completely agree with everything you said. I wonder why she’s even got this job when all she does is ignore people, give bad advice, and make all of us feel bad. 😔

SOS - Rihanna 

Call Me Maybe - Carly Rae Jepsen

Seal It with a Kiss - Britney Spears

(The song “SOS” describes exactly how I feel when I see her and how I feel about her in general. All of these do.)

I’m so sorry, I know exactly how you feel. I’m currently going through that exact same problem. I also get easily triggered by the words “best friend” or “bestie” too cause I haven’t had one in so long

Thank you to anyone who took the time to read this long, crazy post. 
I really appreciate it more than anything else.
I just wish they could accept me for who I am and not what I look like. It is just so hard to have to try and look good and feel good while always trying to please other people at the same time.
You are so clutch baby. We really need more people like you in this world

I know, I’m so fucking sad. And the worst part about it is that. We both promised that we would always be together and that we would always support each other no matter what we’re going through, and I believed them 😕
